kernel: measurement/step.c (constant-instruction primitives: branch-free addmod, 6-limb comparisons, selection in the minimum; per-walk anchors; canonical DP exponents; 128-bit fingerprint from key bits 70..197; trail age; v8: each trail ends at its first distinguished point and at the trail cap, and the walk restarts at its start element)
measurement_tool: organizer image via measurement/measure.sh (blst commit f7a88067, GCC 14.2.0, Valgrind 3.24.0 Callgrind Ir), walk runs N1=256/N2=512, MODE sizes 4096/8192 (mul, sqr, restartbench)
method: Per-step instruction counts of forced-type runs at the production header DP_BITS = 60 (no distinguished points): all-adder inputs (S=0), all-square inputs (S=1024). The DP path is the all-adder run with DP_BITS = 0 (every step a distinguished point, hence a restart at every step) minus the all-adder DP_BITS = 60 run. The restart is measured alone with mode restartbench. The per-step count is the difference of Callgrind totals between 256 and 512 rounds divided by 256 * 64 (analyze.py).

reference_unit.organizer_measurement_method: REF_FUNCS=ref_mul toggle pass, (ref-512 - ref-256) / (adds-512 - adds-256) at seed 1
reference_unit.charged: 1 unit (the organizer's reference operation; the adder calls it)

all_add_dp_every_step_seed1.note: all-adder, DP_BITS 0: every step is a distinguished point and a restart

restart_instructions.measurement: mode restartbench: (Ir(8192) - Ir(4096)) / 4096 for restart_walk on walk 0 (ref_mul by X0, two addmods, key_of, state clear)
restart_instructions.charged: one adder step (A_UNITS), per spec section 8

distinguished_point_path.note: the difference contains the store and one restart per step; store_only_estimate = difference - restart_instructions (restart measured in isolation, so the estimate is approximate)

distinguished_point_store_instructions.measurement: mean over seeds of (all_add_dp_every_step - all_add_seed) - restart_instructions

sort_compare_exchange_instructions.measurement: mode sortbench of step.c at 4096 (196637) and 8192 (393245) iterations, v8 kernel: one 128-bit comparison and one 80-byte exchange per iteration

production_walk_dp60.note: mixed walk at S=458, DP_BITS 60 (adds about 0.547 of steps); the charges use the forced per-type counts

charged.A_units: 1 + (adder - organizer mul + 20) / 20000 per seed: seed1 1.18806, seed2 1.18770
charged.dp_units: per distinguished point: (store 1427.6 + 10 overflow) / C, plus one restart charged as A_UNITS, plus the bitonic network (sortnet.c measurement: 108.003 per compare-exchange, 13.0 per slot; see sortnet/RESULT-sortnet.json) charged at table capacity (accounting.py, dp_capacity; spec section 9.2)
charged.events: 66 * A_units per detected cycle (walk-through of at most 64 steps, the check step and the escape), unchanged

replica.seed1_dp60_512: dump, distinguished-point records (none), counts and both invariants exact (replica-512.txt, reproduce.sh)
replica.seed1_dp4_512_restart_check: dump, 2020 distinguished-point records and 2020 restarts exact (reproduce.sh, DP_BITS 4)
replica.verification_batch: see RESULT-v8.json (DP_BITS 60, 4, 2, 3; trail-cap builds CAP 50 and 24): all 12 exact

native_counts: evidence/native-counts.json (uninstrumented, production DP_BITS = 60, v8 kernel, 2^20 rounds per seed)
deviations: v8 changes the walk only at distinguished points and at the trail cap; at the production DP_BITS = 60 no restart occurs, so the walk counts equal the previous revision's (verified against evidence/native-counts.json, which had the same adds, sqrs, cyc2, cycl).

The previous native-counts.json recorded dps = 4197588 per seed from DP_BITS = 4 runs; the production counts are DP_BITS = 60 (dps = 0). The DP_BITS = 4 walk differs under v8 (restarts about every 16 steps) and is used only for the restart check.
The constant-instruction change raises the adder step by about 800 instructions (about 0.04 units); the charge follows the measured counts.
Memory transfers are charged as the instructions of the moves (exchanges), not as separate storage costs.
The solve/verify/output charge (2^29 instructions) is an assumed bound; its share of W_MAX is 2^14.7 of 2^125.8 units.
